doc.tool: Current state with the agentview (third-person) and wrist images.

doc.code:
TCP pose, gripper opening and the success flags.

Example:
    st = state()
    print(st["tcp_pos"], st["gripper_width"], st["info"].get("success"))

delta_xyz.description: [dx, dy, dz] in metres, at most {{max_move}} m long

gripper.description: Open or close the gripper first (omitted: keep the current command)

doc.tool: Translate {{move_subject}} by {{move_frame}} (at most {{max_move}} m per call), optionally opening or closing the gripper first (the arm holds still until the fingers settle, then moves). The orientation is locked. Returns the new state and images.
doc.code:
Translate the TCP by [dx, dy, dz] m (at most 0.2 m per call) as ~2 cm closed-loop waypoints, optionally opening or closing the gripper first (held still until the fingers settle); stops at success. Returns commanded_m, moved_m, gripper, env_steps, info (flags) and state.

Example:
    r = move_delta([0, 0, -0.04], gripper="open")
    r = move_delta([0, 0, 0], gripper="close")
    print(r["moved_m"], r["info"].get("is_grasped"))

Drive the TCP to a world xyz (m) closed-loop with the gripper command held; returns [frames, info] (one state per control step).

Example:
    x, y, z = state()["tcp_pos"]
    frames, info = servo([x, y, z - 0.02], 1)  # down 2 cm, gripper open
    print(frames[-1]["tcp_pos"], info.get("is_grasped"))

depth.description: Also return metric depth (float32 m, 0 = none) on the same pixels

doc.code:
The latest frame of a camera (with depth: [rgb, depth_m]).

Example:
    rgb = render_camera("wrist")  # uint8 [256, 256, 3]

Camera intrinsics and camera-to-world extrinsic (raw sensor pixels, before the view's orientation and letterbox).

Example:
    meta = get_camera_meta("agentview")
    K, T = meta["intrinsic_K"], meta["extrinsic_cam2world"]

One pd_ee_delta_pos action [dx, dy, dz, gripper] (gripper > 0 open, < 0 close on every robot; [dx, dy, dz] without a gripper; two arms: both concatenated).

Example:
    r = step([0, 0, 0.1, 1])  # up about 1 cm; the Panda's gripper +1 opens
    print(r["state"]["tcp_pos"], r["info"].get("success"))

actions.description: N x 4 floats (N x 3 without a gripper)

doc.code:
Run actions [N, 4] in one call; stops early on termination or success.

Example:
    r = chunk_step([[0.1, 0, 0, 1]] * 5)  # about 5 cm along +x
    print(r["steps"], r["state"]["tcp_pos"])

doc.tool: Whether the arm could reach a world-frame xyz from its current joints (IK only; nothing moves), keeping its orientation unless quat_xyzw is given. status unreachable means a move there would fail or be refused; unknown means the check could not run.
doc.code:
IK reachability of a world xyz from the current joints (nothing moves): status reachable | unreachable | unknown.

Example:
    print(preview_reach([0.0, 0.1, 0.05])["status"])
